+    sorted_hist = sorted(history, key=lambda row: row["value"])

+    # Exploration probability decays from ~0.35 to ~0.1

+            s = statistics.stdev(vals)
+            if s == 0:
+                s = (bounds[i][1] - bounds[i][0]) * 0.05
+        else:
+            s = (bounds[i][1] - bounds[i][0]) * 0.1
+        scales.append(s)
+
+    # 80% chance to exploit around the best point, 20% around the mean of top points
+    if rng.random() < 0.8:

+        factor = 1.0
+
+    new = []

+        x = center[i] + rng.gauss(0.0, factor * scales[i] * 1.2)

+        new.append(x)
+    return new
